steps.note: Start a classic single-stage event suitable for lot-level awarding.
Configure the event to award the entire lot to one vendor.
Apply the first available pricing template before adding line items.
Create multiple line items representing the lot.
Complete the pricing sheet for all lot lines.
Commit the bidding schedule before publishing.
Invite two QA vendors so a winning vendor can be selected by rank.
Publish the event for vendor bidding.
Confirm the event reached a published project page.
Verify the first vendor's bid was accepted.
Submit a competing bid from a different vendor.
Verify the second vendor's bid was accepted.
Close the bidding event before awarding.
Award the whole lot to the lowest-ranked vendor.
Confirm the award proposal was created and submitted.
Complete the award flow and create the purchase order for the awarded lot.
Verify that all lot line items appear in the resulting purchase order.
